`tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` now rounds half-up. I haven't run it or any tests.

`tax_for` was an unimplemented stub (`raise NotImplementedError`), so I wrote the whole function. It multiplies the amount in cents by the rate as a `Decimal`, rounds with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, and returns integer cents with no floats.

The stored "Tax rounding rule" memory said banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) and explicitly forbade half-up. That came from a March 2026 finance review, so I updated the memory to half-up, noted the date of the change, and kept the old rule in its history. The per-line rule is unchanged: round each line's tax separately, then sum, and never round the invoice total. `tax_for` rounds a single amount, so the caller has to apply it line by line.
